events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: The Atlanta Falcons raced to a 17-0 lead and the defense made it stand up, picking off five of Drew Brees' passes and ending his NFL-record touchdown streak with a 23-13 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons pick off Brees 5 times, snap TD streak

headlines.description: Quarterback Ryan Fitzpatrick directed five straight scoring drives in helping the Buffalo Bills keep alive their slim playoff hopes with a 34-18 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills blast Jags to keep slim playoff hopes alive

headlines.description: Russell Wilson connected with Sidney Rice on a 13-yard touchdown with 7:33 left in overtime to lift the Seattle Seahawks to a wild 23-17 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks stun Bears on Wilson's TD toss in OT

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Donnie Avery with no time left to lift the Indianapolis Colts to a dramatic 35-33 comeback win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck lifts Colts past Lions with no time left

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: James Starks had Green Bay's first rushing touchdown in almost two months, Morgan Burnett picked off Christian Ponder twice and the Packers overcame a monster day by Adrian Peterson for a 23-14 victory Sunday over the Minnesota Vikings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers survive Peterson's heroics, top Vikes

headlines.description: The Houston Texans clinched their second straight playoff berth and set a franchise record for wins in a season as they beat the Tennessee Titans 24-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans improve to 11-1, secure playoff spot

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Against the backdrop an unthinkable tragedy, the Kansas City Chiefs gave themselves a reason to be proud Sunday -- and perhaps the impetus to let the healing begin.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quinn, Chiefs top Panthers in wake of tragedy

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Rookie Greg Zuerlein kicked a 54-yard field goal with 26 seconds left in overtime after booting a 53-yarder as time expired in regulation as the St. Louis Rams beat the San Francisco 49ers 16-13 on Sunday, avoiding a second tie in three weeks against the
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams stun 49ers in OT, avoid another tie

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Tom Brady had his least efficient game of the year and even threw an interception, but the New England Patriots took advantage of Miami's mistakes Sunday to win 23-16 and clinch their fourth consecutive AFC East title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats sink Fins, clinch 4th straight AFC East title

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New York Jets

headlines.description: Third-stringer Greg McElroy stepped in for a struggling Mark Sanchez and energized the New York Jets to a 7-6 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McElroy replaces Sanchez, lifts Jets past Cards

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw three touchdowns, including one to defensive tackle Mitch Unrein, to help the Denver Broncos wrap up the AFC West with a 31-23 victory Sunday over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Broncos beat Bucs to clinch AFC West

headlines.description: Brandon Weeden threw for a career-high 364 yards and a touchdown and the Cleveland Browns did just enough to snap a 12-game road losing streak by beating the Oakland Raiders 20-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns top Raiders, snap 12-game road skid

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Andy Dalton scrambled up the middle for a 6-yard touchdown with 4:11 left for the go-ahead score and the Cincinnati Bengals won their fourth straight game, 20-13 over the staggering San Diego Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton rallies surging Bengals past Chargers
Batch, Steelers rally, end Ravens' run at home

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw three touchdown passes to break Troy Aikman's career franchise record, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Philadelphia Eagles 38-33 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo sets Cowboys' TD mark, beats Eagles

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III threw for one touchdown and had a fumble turn into another score, and the Washington Redskins pulled within one game of the NFC East lead with a 17-16 win over the New York Giants on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: RG3, Redskins topple Giants to win 3rd straight
